CloudProject.title: CloudProject
CloudProject.description: A user-owned NOVACUT video editing project synced to Firebase Cloud Firestore.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID who owns this project.

clipCount.description: Number of video clips in the project.

payloadJson.description: Serialized timeline tracks payload (up to 250000 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Per-user subcollection storing NOVACUT video projects owned by userId.
